scope: One assignment file submission lifecycle and its form presentation

browser_observations.case: Old dialog cancellation then different assignment
browser_observations.result: Browser submitted task-b using file registered for task-a; before-http.json records file ID and workStatus 1.

browser_observations.case: New dialog cancellation then different assignment; removed ready file
browser_observations.result: Both attempts showed missing-file error and sent no submission.
File remained selected, displayed retry/error and did not become ready. After fixture fault reset, retry reached ready.
Same registered file preserved. Later successful request used same file ID, trimmed assignment title and workStatus 1; success event observed exactly once.
Submit, cancel, change and remove controls disabled; close icon absent. One successful request and one success event; duplicate invocation separately covered by component test.
Selection cleared immediately. After late upload response, missing-file error persisted; no registration for canceled upload and no task-b submission.
390/768/1440 document widths equal viewport; modal contained horizontally.
Tab developer log empty for error/warn at final inspection.

limitations: Actual Vue dialog, Ant Design and upload adapter; API alias sends real HTTP to loopback synthetic service. No platform login, real database, real role authorization or production data.
Parent @ok refresh and request race recovery verified in source/component tests; actual parent page refresh not browser-accepted.
Qiniu credential/key isolation tested with controlled responses only; no real cloud upload.
Cancel/remove clears dialog selection and stops accepting late responses, but does not delete already transferred or registered files. No orphan garbage collection added.
Network failure may follow an already accepted server write; message asks to check list. Client guard is not server exactly-once delivery.
Generic JUpload and Scratch/ScratchJr/Python editor flows are not changed or accepted by this PR.
Backend contracts require PR20 lineage including PR14 work submission and PR17 file registration. Full authenticated end-to-end acceptance remains pending.
